contentList.content: I should be carving a frozen throne. Not... this.
Three centuries of pacts, and I get a roadside brawl. Splendid.
Cania is watching. Don't embarrass me.
Steel? Against a lady? How common.
Eyes on me, not my master. Afraid?
I've frozen finer things than you.
Kneel or freeze. I won't say it twice.
Look at me, insects. Not the puppet behind me.
This is all your world made? Pitiable.
I'd tell you to run. You're too weak for that.
You can't even pick which of us to face. Telling.
Face me, not my charge. Or is judgment too bright?
Step into the light. The sun already finds you wanting.
You're not worth your own shadow. I'll take both.
Kneel in the dawn, or burn standing.
